subject: Vendor onboarding: PO serial mismatch & spend cap rounding
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@harborgrid.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: HarborGrid Procurement <procure@harborgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding form submitted — PO mismatch and currency note

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the onboarding walkthrough last week. We submitted the vendor onboarding form this morning (attached: vendor_onboarding_form_v3.pdf) and our procurement team also uploaded the spend schedule. Quick heads up: your system shows a PO issued as 1001 but our internal procurement record indicates 1002 — the serials don't align. Also the spend cap on line 2 has been entered in EUR on our side; I believe Redwood expects USD.

This is blocking our first shipment and the procurement team asked me to escalate so we don't lose the allocation window. Can you confirm who can reconcile the PO serials and confirm the accepted currency? Happy to provide any additional docs.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (PDF stub), vendor_initial_spend.csv (CSV stub)

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Procurement Operations
HarborGrid

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@harborgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Onboarding form submitted — PO mismatch and currency note

Thanks for the flag, Lena — looping in Procurement and Ledger (Ben, Marissa, Connor) to triage. Summary of what I see:
- Vendor form submitted today (attached by vendor).
- Red flag: PO serial discrepancy between our onboarding subsystem (shows PO 1001) and HarborGrid (claims PO 1002).
- Currency: HarborGrid submitted spend cap in EUR. We need to confirm Redwood's contracted currency (should be USD for the initial contract) and whether conversion admin needs to happen before PO issuance.

Ben — can you check which system created 1001 vs 1002 (procurement vs finance)?
Marissa — can you confirm ledger mapping and whether a provisional PO move or reversal is required to keep spend tracking clean?
Connor — if serials change, please advise on any downstream SKU/line rerouting we should apply.

Proposed immediate steps: procurement validates authoritative PO serial; finance confirms currency rounding policy; vendor re-issues amended form if needed; we reissue a corrected PO and notify the vendor to proceed.

I can do a quick call if helpful — available 11:30–12:30 today.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@harborgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Onboarding form submitted — PO mismatch and currency note

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 10:05 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben — can you check which system created 1001 vs 1002 (procurement vs finance)?

Checked the logs. Short version: our Procurement Provisioner (proc-service) pre-allocated PO serial 1002 as a provisional token when the vendor record was drafted last week; Finance AP then ingested the onboarding packet this morning and auto-generated a finalized PO 1001 because it matched the AP ingest and invoice template. The two services are not yet reconciled for provisional tokens — that's the root cause.

Impact: both PO numbers exist in our systems (1001 finalized, 1002 provisional). If we close 1001 and promote 1002 we risk time drift on AP invoices; if we retire 1002 we have to ensure procurement allocation windows are not lost.

Recommendation (fastest, lowest risk): retire 1001 (cancel finalized duplicate), promote 1002 to finalized and issue a short amendment notice to the vendor referencing both numbers for audit trails. Finance should record a zeroed offset on 1001 to keep bookkeeping consistent.

I'll prepare the cancellation note for 1001 — need Finance sign-off to proceed.

Ben
Sr. Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: po-1001-pdf-stub.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Lena Park <lena.park@harborgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Onboarding form submitted — PO mismatch and currency note

Thanks Ben — and thanks, Lena, for sending the form. A couple of ledger/line-item notes from my side after reviewing HarborGrid's spend schedule:
- Line 1 (SKU HG-CORE-01): quantity on the onboarding form is 10 but the spend schedule shows 12. We should align to the schedule (12) and update the PO line, unless vendor confirms 10 is correct.
- Line 2 (professional services): HarborGrid submitted cap as EUR 45,000. Per Redwood policy, onboarding spend caps default to USD in our procurement system. For now we'll store the vendor-reported currency as a metadata field and apply our standard FX conversion (close-of-business FX rate on acceptance). Please confirm whether HarborGrid wants us to keep the spend cap in EUR on the PO or convert to USD prior to issuing a finalized PO.
- Ledger mapping: use GL 5.2.10 for hardware and GL 8.1.03 for services (see attached mapping sheet). I'll attach the vendor_spend_schedule.xlsx with suggested line adjustments.

If procurement is going to promote 1002 as the canonical PO, we should do that AFTER the vendor confirms the corrected quantities and currency preference. Otherwise we'll create a change order immediately after issuance.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Cost Accounting & Ledger Integrity
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: vendor_spend_schedule.xlsx)

From: Lena Park <lena.park@harborgrid.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Onboarding form submitted — PO mismatch and currency note

Hi all — thanks for the quick triage.

We confirm the spend schedule quantity is correct (12 on HG-CORE-01). We accidentally left the original form at 10 — apologies, that was an internal sync miss. Regarding currency: HarborGrid's procurement policy lists the contract in EUR, but we can sign an amendment to accept Redwood's USD-denominated PO for this initial order if that simplifies payment rails. If you prefer keeping the cap in EUR on the PO, we can provide a notarized FX statement and sign the amended onboarding form.

Action items from our side:
- I'll re-submit the onboarding form with corrected line 1 quantity and explicit currency selection.
- I'll route the amendment to e-signature — please send a DocuSign amendment referencing "PO 1001 / provisional 1002" so our legal can sign and return quickly.

This is blocking shipment (we have a 2-week window on the hardware allocation). If you can reissue the canonical PO today with a provisional hold for the allocation, we can proceed with the e-sign and confirm receipt.

Thanks,
Lena
(Attachment: amended_onboarding_form_v3_signed_stub.pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Lena Park <lena.park@harborgrid.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Onboarding form submitted — PO mismatch and currency note

Thanks everyone — summary and agreed next steps (finalizing here so we have a single audit trail):

1) Procurement (Ben): will cancel PO 1001 and promote provisional PO 1002 to finalized by EOD tomorrow, and record a zeroed offset entry on 1001 for audit. Ben, please confirm when cancellation notice is filed so we can attach the cancellation stub to the vendor record.

2) Ledger/Finance (Marissa): apply ledger remap to GL 5.2.10 (hardware) and GL 8.1.03 (services) once the vendor's amended onboarding form is received. Marissa will also run the FX conversion using close-of-business rate on the PO acceptance date if HarborGrid confirms they want us to convert to USD.

3) Vendor (Lena/HarborGrid): please upload the amended onboarding form and sign the DocuSign amendment. For the audit trail reference both numbers: "PO 1001 (canceled) / PO 1002 (finalized)". HarborGrid confirmed updated quantity (12) on HG-CORE-01 and can accept USD if needed.

4) Connor: after PO promotion, please validate there are no orphaned line-item routings in our fulfillment queue and update any SKU pointers.

Timeline: aiming to close all items within 48 hours given the allocation window.

Related links: DocuSign amendment (https://docusign.net/na1/documents/ABC12345-amendment), onboarding packet in Drive (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcD-example-drive-link).

I'll mark the ticket as high priority and follow up if anything slips past the 48-hour window. Thanks for fast responses and Lena — appreciate HarborGrid's flexibility on currency.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference
